entries.title: I Corinthians 9:1
segments: ¶Am I not an apostle? Am I not free? Have I not seen Jesus Christ our Lord? Are you not my work in the Lord?

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:2
segments: If I am not an apostle to others, yet doubtless I am to you. For you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord.

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:3
segments: ¶My defense to those who examine me is this:

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:4
segments: Do we have no right to eat and drink?

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:5
segments: Do we have no right to take along a believing wife, as [do] also the other apostles, the brothers of the Lord, and Cephas?

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:6
segments: Or [is it] only Barnabas and I [who] have no right to refrain from working?

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:7
segments: Who ever goes to war at his own expense? Who plants a vineyard and does not eat of its fruit? Or who tends a flock and does not drink of the milk of the flock?

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:8
segments: Do I say these things as a [mere] man? Or does not the law say the same also?

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:9
segments: For it is written in the law of Moses, "You shall not muzzle an ox while it treads out the grain." Is it oxen God is concerned about?

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:10
segments: Or does He say [it] altogether for our sakes? For our sakes, no doubt, [this] is written, that he who plows should plow in hope, and he who threshes in hope should be partaker of his hope.

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:11
segments: If we have sown spiritual things for you, [is it] a great thing if we reap your material things?

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:12
segments: If others are partakers of [this] right over you, [are] we not even more? Nevertheless we have not used this right, but endure all things lest we hinder the gospel of Christ.

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:13
segments: Do you not know that those who minister the holy things eat [of the things] of the temple, and those who serve at the altar partake of [the offerings of] the altar?

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:14
segments: Even so the Lord has commanded that those who preach the gospel should live from the gospel.

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:15
segments: ¶But I have used none of these things, nor have I written these things that it should be done so to me; for it [would be] better for me to die than that anyone should make my boasting void.

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:16
segments: For if I preach the gospel, I have nothing to boast of, for necessity is laid upon me; yes, woe is me if I do not preach the gospel!

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:17
segments: For if I do this willingly, I have a reward; but if against my will, I have been entrusted with a stewardship.

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:18
segments: What is my reward then? That when I preach the gospel, I may present the gospel of Christ without charge, that I may not abuse my authority in the gospel.

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:19
segments: ¶For though I am free from all [men], I have made myself a servant to all, that I might win the more;

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:20
segments: and to the Jews I became as a Jew, that I might win Jews; to those [who are] under the law, as under the law, that I might win those [who are] under the law;

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:21
segments: to those [who are] without law, as without law (not being without law toward God, but under law toward Christ), that I might win those [who are] without law;

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:22
segments: to the weak I became as weak, that I might win the weak. I have become all things to all [men], that I might by all means save some.

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:23
segments: Now this I do for the gospel's sake, that I may be partaker of it with [you].

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:24
segments: ¶Do you not know that those who run in a race all run, but one receives the prize? Run in such a way that you may obtain [it].

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:25
segments: And everyone who competes [for the prize] is temperate in all things. Now they [do it] to obtain a perishable crown, but we [for] an imperishable [crown].

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:26
segments: Therefore I run thus: not with uncertainty. Thus I fight: not as [one who] beats the air.

entries.title: I Corinthians 9:27
segments: But I discipline my body and bring [it] into subjection, lest, when I have preached to others, I myself should become disqualified.
